title: Properness makes the chart image of an open parameter set a neighbourhood of ψ(v₀) in N
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, N, W ⊆ ℝ^P, V, V₀ ⊆ ℝ^d, ψ : ℝ^d → ℝ^P and v₀ ∈ ℝ^d. Suppose W is open, ψ is continuous on V and injective on V, ψ(V) = W ∩ N, V ∩ ψ⁻¹(K) is compact for every compact K ⊆ W, V₀ is open, V₀ ⊆ V and v₀ ∈ V₀. Then there is ρ > 0 such that N ∩ B_ρ(ψ(v₀)) ⊆ ψ(V₀).
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (N W : Set (Euclid P)) (V V₀ : Set (Euclid d)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P) (v₀ : Euclid d), IsOpen W → ContinuousOn ψ V → InjOn ψ V → ψ '' V = W ∩ N → (∀ K ⊆ W, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) → IsOpen V₀ → V₀ ⊆ V → v₀ ∈ V₀ → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ N ∩ ball (ψ v₀) ρ ⊆ ψ '' V₀
